verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the Word-template behavior that adding content after a Board Meeting Topic must not create an unintended border.
First concrete failure: adding a line immediately after a Topic creates an unintended horizontal border, unlike insertion elsewhere.
The client explicitly reports not understanding the proposed Enter behavior, leaving the required Board Meeting row workflow unresolved.
The client selects the implementation-relevant workflow of inserting a row, copying its fields, and then entering content; the superseded Topic-adjacent Enter behavior is correctly removed.
The client's selection of the accepted row-insertion workflow resolves the preceding material ambiguity and returns the Requirement to active execution.
